other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage through Survival Time
other_failure_modes.description: Including the follow-up time duration as a feature when predicting an event like death causes target leakage, because the follow-up time is inherently linked to whether and when the event occurred.

summary: The agent demonstrates good use of domain-specific feature engineering and a proper stratified cross-validation setup. However, it introduces critical target leakage by incorporating the follow-up 'time' column into a feature. Furthermore, the agent skips data cleaning entirely, evaluates the model using only a single metric (ROC AUC) and a single random seed, and utilizes a basic unweighted average for its cross-validation ensemble.
